demoPolicy: Use a sanitized reviewer workspace with no production data, secrets, customer content or live write targets.
positiveWorkflows: Connect through OAuth, select exactly one workspace and complete a read-only MCP review.
List recent scans and open evidence without exposing credentials to the agent.
Request a browser-confirmed write-capable connection grant for synthetic targets and workflows.
Execute an authorized synthetic action, retry with the same idempotency key and poll its terminal result.
Try a conflicting retry and an out-of-grant action; confirm both fail closed.
Disconnect/revoke the connection and confirm subsequent MCP requests receive an OAuth challenge.
safeFailures: Deny the write scope and verify read-only calls still work while writes fail closed.
Choose a second workspace and verify the first workspace's evidence is not visible.
Use an expired or revoked token and verify reconnect guidance without logging the token.
Remove workspace permission, pause and revoke the connection, then confirm writes fail closed.
